authority: Current researcher continuation instruction; no human-rating reinterpretation, financial spending, private access, generation or frozen evidence amendment

decision_alternatives.path: A: qualified new English target-speaker cohort
decision_alternatives.value: Direct RQ1 transport and new natural conversation observations; possible independent source replication
decision_alternatives.risk: Source-supported F, chronology and actual participant independence must be established before inference

decision_alternatives.value: Uses actual100 responses to distinguish prompt-processing from output-generation costs without human ratings; supports RQ1/RQ4
decision_alternatives.risk: Native timing is not semantic fidelity; observational latency alone is not a new algorithm or controlled quality-efficiency comparison

decision_alternatives.value: Direct RQ3 with same architecture/quantization and documented tokenizer/template differences

AMI_metadata_screen.license: Official distribution and https://groups.inf.ed.ac.uk/ami/corpus/license.shtml state CC BY4.0; preserve attribution and limitations on personality/privacy rights
AMI_metadata_screen.download_limit: One official manual text/annotation archive, <=40MiB, and relevant public documentation only; no audio/video or identity enrichment
AMI_metadata_screen.access: Read archive directory and metadata/participant/meeting definitions only initially; do not inspect word, segment, summary or dialogue target bodies
AMI_metadata_screen.include: Only officially documented naturally occurring N meetings; exclude all S design-roleplay and B fictitious-scenario meetings, even though some are listed under non-scenario
AMI_metadata_screen.qualification: Stable participant identity across at least three separately dated authentic meetings, English material, source chronology and lawful minimized research use
AMI_metadata_screen.no_inference: Metadata capacity does not establish personal facts or corpus suitability; body access requires a separate frozen source-selection rule. No generation allocation from this policy.

ICSI_alternative: The old fully participant-and-partner-disjoint Bed branch remains STOP with0 qualified cases. A separately registered new-target-speaker cohort with exposed partners may be evaluated transparently using unopened Bro/Bns bodies only after an exposure-aware source policy. It must never be labelled fully independent replication or a repaired Bed study.
review_boundary: All99 original human judgments remain unchanged and provisional, one UNAVAILABLE retained, protected mapping unopened. No assumptions about4/5 scale anchors.
privacy: All authentic records, metadata, source offsets and future prompts stay in ignored.local. Public documents contain methods, aggregates and hashes only. No redistribution of raw personal dialogue.
stopping: No repeated screening to produce favorable model outcomes. If metadata is inadequate, preserve the bounded negative result and choose the next defensible path before any body access or generation.
